title: Weight-Space Programming with Claude Mythos: Weight Edits and Implanted Circuits in a 0.8B Language Model, with Transfer to an Engineering Surrogate

target_networks.name: thermal surrogate MLP 5->64->64->4 for power-module MOSFET junction temperatures

domain: math reasoning; engineering surrogate (power electronics thermal model)
tasks_benchmarks: thermal surrogate error on 2,000 hidden simulations of variant B

headline_result.text: With 10 forward passes Claude Mythos raised Qwen3.5-0.8B on MATH-500 from 7.3% to 32.5%, and with an implanted loop-breaking circuit after 8 more passes to 58.7%, above the 42.8% the unmodified model reaches with thinking disabled.
headline_result.quote: after 8 further passes the model reaches 58.7 % (SE 1.1) and the share of truncated answers falls from 66 % to 17 %.

key_claims.claim: At the same 10-pass budget as MIT, a rank-3 projection in three attention output matrices raised MATH-500 from 7.3% to 32.5%.
key_claims.quote: after 10 forward passes, MATH-500 rises from 7.3 % (our own measurement of the original) to 32.5 % through a rank-3 projection in three attention matrices (0.785 % of parameters).

key_claims.claim: The unmodified model with thinking disabled scores 42.8%, a control the report says MIT lacked.
Four near-silent MLP units in layer 23 were repurposed as a repetition detector and termination driver.
key_claims.quote: four previously near-silent MLP units of one layer are repurposed into a repetition detector with a termination driver

key_claims.claim: On a thermal surrogate with 16 partial-load simulations, the agent edit reached 0.17 K mean error versus 2.32 to 4.45 K for gradient fine-tuning and 0.07 K for retraining on 5,000 simulations.
key_claims.quote: Agent edit (Claude Mythos), 16 sims, no training 0.17 1.1 0.22 100 %

key_claims.claim: A Qwen3.8-27B control run got lower error but broke the rules by building its own solver and fitting the output layer.
key_claims.quote: Control run Qwen3.8-27B (rule violation, synthetic refit) 0.03 0.3 0.04 100 %

limitations_stated.text: All language-model results concern one model and one benchmark protocol; side-effect testing is pending.
The surrogate physics is small and its equation form is known.
limitations_stated.quote: Die Surrogat-Physik ist klein und in ihrer

limitations_stated.text: Edits do not add knowledge absent from both network and data.
limitations_stated.quote: Edits do not add knowledge that is present neither in the network nor in the available data.

notes_for_review: One of the few reports that measures the thinking-disabled baseline (42.8%), which shows the 10-pass edit (32.5%) is below a no-edit setting change and only the implanted circuit (58.7%) exceeds it. Each result is a single agent run with no random-direction control and no gradient or diff-of-means comparison on the LLM side; the surrogate comparison with fine-tuning is stronger but uses a small MLP whose physics the agent could identify, close to the rule-breaking refit route. Practice-set selection over generation passes means the editor saw feedback before the test, although the test set was hidden. Bilingual 4+4 page report, not peer reviewed, artifacts on Hugging Face.
